headline: Fiscal Year 2028 preliminary budget and superintendent search among updates on the agenda.
summary: Updates on the superintendent, K-3 literacy, and facilities are on the agenda. A preliminary budget for Fiscal Year 2028 is also listed, along with an update on the superintendent search.
location: South Lawrence East Complex Auditorium, 165 Crawford Street, Lawrence, Mass.
